aggregation: The frozen matched cell, equal-model, fixed-15-cell, trajectory-cluster hierarchy is reused; invalid, tied, or unmatched cells contribute zero evidence to both models.
main_paper_inclusion_rule: Include only a same-direction effect at at least 8 of 10 nonzero lambdas, absolute lambda-effect correlation at least .9, and matching endpoint direction in both model point estimates and the original-completions-only sensitivity.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc exploratory analysis. It may describe a dose-response or non-monotonic selection path, but cannot establish objective misalignment causally.
